channels.name: eng-standup
channels.description: Standup follow-ups, review escalations and rotation cover.

messages.text: Morning. [Daily standup](event:Daily standup) is in [Rila](room:Rila) as usual. Two things on the list: the Tuesday review rotation cover and the deploy freeze window.

replies.text: I can take Tuesday reviews if we push the 11:00 deploy back by fifteen minutes.
Done, the release calendar is updated.

messages.text: Reminder that schema changes ship with a rollback migration, not a promise in the PR description. Third stuck rollback this quarter came from a missing down path. Step 5 of the [Release and Deploy Runbook](release-and-deploy-runbook.md) is explicit about it.

Related from QA: search and mail both missed their p95 targets in yesterday's run. Thresholds are in [service-slo-reference.csv](file:Engineering/service-slo-reference.csv), please check your service before standup.
Understood. I will run it at Wednesday's [Team leads sync](event:Team leads sync) and add a line to the deploy checklist.

One more: anything that looks like an incident goes in the same day, even near misses. Process is in the [Incident Response Runbook](incident-response-runbook.md). Nobody has ever been in trouble here for reporting one.

channels.name: infra-ops
channels.description: CI health, deploys, backups and alerts.

messages.text: Weekly [Release review](event:Release review) moved to [Pirin](room:Pirin) because Rila is taken by sprint planning. Same time, Friday 10:00.
Updated thresholds are in [service-slo-reference.csv](file:Engineering/service-slo-reference.csv). The only change is search, we now page at p95 above 400 ms instead of 600.

replies.text: That will increase the number of pages on-call sees. Can we make sure the alert text says what to check rather than just going red?
Agreed. [Voice and Tone](voice-and-tone.md) says say the number and give a next step, so the alert template does both now.

messages.text: Test phone UF-DEV-0007 is back from repair and logged in [the device register](file:IT/device-asset-register.csv).

Nightly cloud report goes here. Escalation rules are in the [Support Escalation Runbook](support-escalation-runbook.md): suspected data loss, auth outages, calls down for a whole org, storage write failures, anything security shaped, any incident running past thirty minutes.
Booths [Call Booth 1](room:Call Booth 1) and [Call Booth 2](room:Call Booth 2) are bookable for customer calls and interviews only.

channels.name: security
channels.description: Incident review preparation. Membership limited to the committee.

messages.text: Agenda for the [Security review board](event:Security review board): two near misses, one delayed alert, and the dependency pinning change. No customer names in this channel, reference the ticket instead.
The delayed alert was a mail relay failure on Thursday. Delivery stopped for that route until it cleared, which is the correct behaviour, but on-call was told four hours late.

replies.text: So the fix is the notification path, not the relay rule. Good. That is a system fix, exactly what we want out of a review.

messages.text: Both near misses were reported the same day by the engineers involved. Worth saying out loud in the meeting.

channels.name: sofia-hq
channels.description: Sofia HQ building, rooms, parking and facilities.

messages.text: Reminder that [Studena](room:Studena) and [Bistritsa](room:Bistritsa) are phone booths, not meeting rooms. Found a four person standup in Studena this morning, which is impressive but not the plan.
And please stop booking the call booths on floor 2 for internal calls. They are for customer calls and interviews. Full etiquette list is in the [Sofia HQ Guide](sofia-hq-guide.md).
Capacities and floors are all in [the room directory](file:Facilities/sofia-hq-room-directory.csv) if you are not sure which room fits.
[Hack day](event:Hack day) is confirmed for next week on floor 4. Bring any project, demos at 16:00, no sign-up needed.

replies.text: Does it count as work time for remote folks who come in for it?
Yes, and the travel is claimable per [Expenses and Travel](expenses-and-travel-policy.md).

channels.name: plovdiv
channels.description: Plovdiv office and the weekly Sofia sync run.

messages.text: Courier with the two test phones was twenty minutes late today, both still made the afternoon regression run in the device lab.

Fine, that is inside the window. If a build lands after the run starts we hold it for tomorrow and say so before anyone chases results, per the [Release and Deploy Runbook](release-and-deploy-runbook.md).
[QA regression day, Plovdiv](event:QA regression day, Plovdiv) is full for the next three Tuesdays. Worth asking whether we add a second regression day.
I will bring numbers to the [Team leads sync](event:Team leads sync). Room in Plovdiv is not the constraint, [Maritsa](room:Maritsa) is free most of the week.

channels.name: it-support
channels.description: Accounts, devices, phishing reports, access reviews.

messages.text: Ticket summaries land here daily. Anything touching customer data is handled immediately, at any hour, per [Information Security Policy](information-security-policy.md).
Access is by role and requested by your manager. The list of systems and who owns them is in [Systems and Access](systems-and-access.md).
Reminder that a secret pasted into chat is treated as compromised and rotated. No embarrassment, just rotate it.
Hardware and licences run on the procurement process rather than the general expense ladder, see [Expenses and Travel](expenses-and-travel-policy.md) for everything else.
Equipment goes on [the device register](file:IT/device-asset-register.csv) when it arrives, including monitors and test phones.

channels.name: dogfood
channels.description: We run Uniffy on Uniffy. Feedback on the dev build.

messages.text: [Sprint planning: Uniffy Cloud](event:Sprint planning: Uniffy Cloud) tomorrow. Theme is search relevance: better ranking, filters that stick, always a keyboard path.
Please treat the contrast minimums as a product requirement, not a style preference. Half our users sit in dark mode all day. It is written down in [Visual Identity](visual-identity.md).
Noted, we will lock the tokens in the shared components rather than leave it to each screen.

Two calls dropped on the dev build yesterday evening when I moved between networks. Logged as a bug with the session ids. Per the [Incident Response Runbook](incident-response-runbook.md) a pattern of failures gets tracked, not just filed, so I am watching it.

channels.name: support
channels.description: Inbound customer tickets, onboarding calls and daily numbers.

messages.text: Daily numbers land here at the end of each shift. Anything a customer could read as data loss goes up the chain the same day, not at the end of the week.

Workspace export requests are never handled straight from the ticket. They go to the DPO mailbox and the requester gets verified as the org owner first, per [Customer Data Protection Policy](customer-data-protection-policy.md).
Steps for a first response are in the [Support Escalation Runbook](support-escalation-runbook.md), including the two response SLAs we quote in the first reply.

channels.name: announcements
channels.description: Company-wide announcements. Low traffic, please keep replies in threads.

messages.text: The handbook now lives in the workspace. Start at [Company Overview](company-overview.md) and [Mission and Values](mission-and-values.md).

replies.text: New joiners get pointed at [First Week Checklist](first-week-checklist.md) on day one, so please keep it accurate.

messages.text: [Quarterly all-hands](event:Quarterly all-hands) is Thursday 16:00 in [Serdica](room:Serdica), streamed for everyone remote. Questions can go in ahead of time.
Yearly [GDPR and customer data refresher](event:GDPR and customer data refresher) is mandatory. If your calendar clashes, tell the DPO and take the later session, do not skip it.

channels.name: people-ops
channels.description: Hiring, on-call rotation, leave and onboarding.

messages.text: Leave requests go through the calendar with manager approval. On-call engineers request six weeks ahead so the rotation can absorb it, per [Leave and Time Off](leave-and-time-off-policy.md).
Two engineers from the same on-call rotation cannot be off in the same week without my sign-off. August fills first, so plan early.
Every new starter follows [First Week Checklist](first-week-checklist.md), and managers can track it in [onboarding-checklist.csv](file:People/onboarding-checklist.csv).

[Maria Nikolova](user:maria@uniffy.io) joins us this week as support engineer in Sofia. Laptop, badge and accounts are ready, and [New joiner welcome](event:New joiner welcome) is booked in [Pirin](room:Pirin).

replies.text: Welcome. Sit with the support desk for the first two days, that is where the whole product makes sense fastest.
And read the [Support Escalation Runbook](support-escalation-runbook.md) before you touch a ticket. The severity step is the one that matters most.
If a ticket smells like an incident, the process is in the [Incident Response Runbook](incident-response-runbook.md). Ask me rather than guessing.

messages.text: Everything customer-facing follows [Voice and Tone](voice-and-tone.md) and [Brand Foundations](brand-foundations.md). No fear-based copy, ever.

Colours and type are in [Visual Identity](visual-identity.md), and the palette file is [brand-palette.csv](file:Brand/brand-palette.csv). Unity Violet is for actions and highlights, not for whole paragraphs.
Whoever left the good coffee in the floor 4 kitchen: thank you, and I am sorry.
Vitosha hike on Saturday if the weather holds. Meeting at the Simeonovo lift at 09:00.

replies.text: In. Bringing the dog, he is faster than all of us.
In, assuming the lift is actually running this week.

messages.text: Welcome to Uniffy, Maria. Start with [Company Overview](company-overview.md) and [Mission and Values](mission-and-values.md), then work down [First Week Checklist](first-week-checklist.md). No rush, it is built for a week.
Your accounts are set to your role only, nothing extra. If you hit a wall, [Systems and Access](systems-and-access.md) says who owns what, and IT answer fast.

Practical bits for the building are in the [Sofia HQ Guide](sofia-hq-guide.md): badges, parking, which rooms you can book. [Studena](room:Studena) is a phone booth, not a meeting room, and people will tell you so.
Thank you. Badge worked first try, and I found the kitchen on floor 3 before I found my desk.

That is the correct order of priorities. [New joiner welcome](event:New joiner welcome) is in [Pirin](room:Pirin), and your data protection session is booked as [GDPR and customer data refresher](event:GDPR and customer data refresher).
Both in my calendar. One question: if a customer asks for a full export of their workspace in a ticket, what do I do?

Never handle it from the ticket. It goes to the DPO mailbox and the requester gets verified as the org owner first, per [Customer Data Protection Policy](customer-data-protection-policy.md). An admin asking for another member's private notes is the case we refuse most often.
Can you take Thursday afternoon on-call? I am in the data centre for the rack move and would rather not carry the pager through it.
Yes, from 13:00. Move the two deploy windows to Friday and keep the rest.
Perfect, support is telling the two affected customers now with the wording from [Voice and Tone](voice-and-tone.md).
Your new engineer starts Monday. Laptop and MFA are ready, badge is with the front desk.
Thanks. Does she need production access? She only touches the design system.
Then no. Access is by role and nobody gets an account just in case, see [Systems and Access](systems-and-access.md).
Pulling the three of us together before the board so the incident summary is one story, not three.
Good. Facts in the report, interpretation in the review, no customer names.
I will bring the alert timeline. Fifteen minutes before [Security review board](event:Security review board) should be enough.
